title: Brain Impact Neuroscience: Tailor-made protocols to measure emotional responses
summary: As consumers increasingly seek products with emotional benefits, the fragrance and beauty industry is looking for robust scientific evidence to substantiate these claims. Founded in 2008, Brain Impact is the only company to use functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) to generate actionable scientific insights addressing these challenges.
